name: 野生动物花园
description: 十六位花丛中的野生朋友：花瓣鬃毛的狮子、长颈鹿、大象、斑马、河马、猴子、犀牛、打瞌睡的猎豹、鹦鹉、火烈鸟、狐獴、陆龟、巨嘴鸟、大猩猩、变色龙和鸵鸟。
style: Children's coloring book page, square 1:1. Pure white background with a wide empty white margin on all sides; nothing touches the edges. Bold uniform thick black outlines, same weight everywhere. No shading, no grey, no texture, no fur, no hatching, no black fills except tiny eye dots, no text, no border frame. Every shape fully closed. One large friendly safari animal, centered, in a simple garden with big flowers and leaves. About 16 large closed areas to color. Eyes are small solid black dots, smile is one short line. Very simple, cute, for a 3-year-old.
